description: An overhead still life on a cream, textured work surface shows a wooden tray with five compartments of rectangular material swatches in ivory, gray, blue, ochre, and charcoal. Two cream boards with brass clips sit beneath the tray. The left board holds an ochre rectangle fitted within a border; the right has a recessed rectangular opening with a blue rectangle partly covering it. A curved blue arrow runs from the tray's blue compartment toward that blue rectangle. A long transparent ruler or measuring frame with fine tick marks and brass corner fasteners lies across the bottom. A shallow ceramic dish of torn scraps is partly cropped at upper left, larger blue swatches are stacked at upper right, and torn paper, thread, and dark grains scatter along both sides. Warm cream and brass, soft shadows, tactile fibers, and an orderly central arrangement give the scene a quiet craft-workshop mood, with peripheral scraps adding a sense of material handling.
